description: Implementation of DHCPv4 Client Request Handler interface, managing DHCPv4 client instances, handling get/set requests, and monitoring updates within a TR-069 host interface context.

classes.name: DHCPv4ClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles DHCPv4 client requests, manages instances, and monitors DHCPv4 client state changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of DHCPv4ClientReqHandler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current number of DHCPv4 clients to zero.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; currently always returns true.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: De-initializes the handler, closing all DHCPv4 client instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests; currently not supported, returns NOT_HANDLED.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for DHCPv4 client info such as Interface, IPRouters, DNSServers.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Retrieves notification enable status for DHCPv4 client parameters.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Sets notification enable status for DHCPv4 client parameters.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for DHCPv4 client updates.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks DHCPv4 client instances for changes and triggers callbacks for updates.
